method: Smart-project charts, each independently area-normalized, then fixed-pixel shelf packing; per-instance scale compensation via logarithmic UV variants. No UV tiling.
exceptions: Terrain, earth rim and water keep their original UVs; the unique-surface requirement is applied to placed props.
UV reuse between instances of the same reusable prop is intentional. Within each prop mesh, charts do not overlap.
Triangle density varies within curved projected charts; chart-average density is normalized. Quantified triangle percentiles are reported.
Generated atlas is 1254 square (627 pixels per material quadrant), so the target uses actual native pixels, not the requested 2048 size.
